The regulator will prioritise risk-based, joint inspections using alerts, complaints and market intelligence while easing compliance burdens for well-governed market intermediaries. This key financial update highlights evolving market dynamics, strategic corporate disclosures, and broader economic sentiment as investors track earnings, regulatory developments, and sector.

news.title: Reliance Industries, ITC among 10 stocks that saw highest buying by LIC in Q1. See full list
news.description: LIC increased its holdings in several major stocks during Q1FY27, with Bharti Airtel, Maruti Suzuki and ITC among the biggest buys, based on Prime Database data. This key financial update highlights evolving market dynamics, strategic corporate disclosures, and broader economic sentiment as investors track earnings, regulatory developments, and sector shifts closely.

news.title: Vedanta and Infosys among 5 stocks with highest dividend yield. Check details
news.description: Five high-dividend-yield stocks include Vedanta, Gujarat Pipavav Port, Castrol India, TCS and Infosys. As of July 29, 2026, Vedanta topped the list with a 12.9% yield, followed by Gujarat Pipavav Port at 6.9%. Investors should consider fundamentals, valuation, sustainability of dividends and risks alongside dividend yield. This key financial update highlights evolving market dynamics, strategic corporate disclosures, and broader economic.

news.title: Apollo Micro Systems Q1 Results: Firm posts record June-quarter profit at Rs 25 crore; revenue surges 88% YoY
news.description: Apollo Micro Systems reported a 43% year-on-year rise in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 25.2 crore, while revenue surged 88% to Rs 251.3 crore. EBITDA rose 18% to Rs 48 crore, though margins moderated. The defence company said its best-ever first-quarter performance reflects strong execution and continued sector demand. This key financial update highlights evolving market dynamics, strategic corporate.

news.title: India's resilient economy to support markets but global risks remain elevated: Sebi
news.description: India's financial markets are poised for growth, buoyed by robust domestic economic fundamentals like strong consumer demand and proactive government spending. Nevertheless, international geopolitical tensions and fluctuating commodity prices present daunting challenges. Consequently, there may be fluctuations in foreign capital inflows, which could affect market stability. Nonetheless, SEBI remains optimistic about India's potential to outperform globally, despite these external challenges.

news.title: F&O Talk: Smallcaps look strong on charts, says Sudeep Shah; outlines Trent, Swiggy, Kalyan Jewellers strategy
news.description: SBI Securities’ Sudeep Shah expects Nifty to remain rangebound, with 24,300–24,800 as key levels. He prefers a buy-on-dips strategy, citing constructive trends. Smallcaps remain bullish, while FII short covering could support markets. Traders should watch key technical levels for Nifty, Trent, Kalyan Jewellers and Swiggy for directional cues. This key financial update highlights evolving market dynamics, strategic corporate disclosures.

news.title: Blackstone's AGS Health files updated draft papers for $500 million India IPO
news.description: In a significant move, AGS Health, operating under Blackstone, has filed revised draft documents for its upcoming IPO in India, which is projected at 48 billion rupees. This offering features a new share release, as Blackstone aims to divest shares worth 30 billion rupees. Notably, AGS Health, known for its revenue cycle management services for U.S. hospitals, achieved a profit.

news.title: Foreign flows into Indian bonds may remain muted despite tax relief: SBI Funds
news.description: Foreign investment in Indian government bonds is projected to stay subdued as global yields alongside domestic interest rates reduce investor attraction. The postponement of India's inclusion in global bond indices further curbs foreign portfolio investments. The Reserve Bank of India is anticipated to keep interest rates steady for a considerable duration, with heightened global yields providing minimal support to local.

news.title: LIC flags pressure on customer incomes even as Q1 profit rises 23%
news.description: LIC expects pressure on household savings to continue, weighing on premium growth, while a shift towards higher-margin non-par products helped boost profitability and strengthened the insurer's capital position in the June quarter.

news.title: Hindalco beats Q1 estimates, remains cautious on bauxite auctions
news.description: The Aditya Birla Group metal flagship reported an almost 75% year-on-year jump in the June-quarter net profit attributable to owners at ₹7,013 crore.

news.title: Ola Electric’s revenue decline enters 7th quarter; company moves to settle Sebi probe
news.description: Q1 revenue slumps 45% to ₹455 crore as the EV maker seeks an early resolution on Sebi’s disclosure probe without admitting liability.

news.title: Shapoorji Pallonji's record bond issue finds a new class of investors
news.description: Private wealth managers are parceling out pieces of the ₹21,350 crore unrated, unlisted debt issue, selling investors a future payoff tied to Tata Sons' potential IPO.

news.title: Cummins India faces margin, valuation hurdles despite robust demand
news.description: Cummins India's Q1 margin disappointed despite healthy revenue growth. Pricing actions, export recovery and rising data centre demand will be key to restoring profitability.

news.title: EIH shares drop 6% after the announcement of Q1FY27 results
news.description: EIH shares fell 6% to ₹307 after mixed Q1 earnings were announced, with a 52% QoQ profit decline despite a 3-fold YoY increase. The company plans significant expansion, signing agreements for six new luxury hotels aimed at capitalizing on growth opportunities.

news.title: Behari Lal Engineering IPO price band set at Rs 271-285, issue opens on August 12
news.description: Behari Lal Engineering will launch its IPO on August 12 with a price band of Rs 271–285 per share, aiming to raise over Rs 301 crore through a fresh issue and an offer for sale. The company plans to use the proceeds to expand manufacturing capacity, install rooftop solar systems, repay debt, and support general corporate purposes.

news.title: Adani Green Energy shares can rally up to 23%. Why Axis Capital, Elara initiated coverage
news.description: Brokerages Axis Capital and Elara Capital initiated coverage on Adani Green Energy, citing its ambitious plan to expand renewable energy capacity to 50 GW and strong long-term growth prospects. The firms see up to 23% upside, backed by robust capacity additions, improving cash flows and India's accelerating clean energy transition.

news.title: Godrej Consumer shares slide 4% after Q1 margin falls amid commodity inflation; Rs 5/share dividend declared
news.description: Godrej Consumer Products shares fell 4.3% after the FMCG major reported its June quarter results. Consolidated net profit rose 12% year-on-year to Rs 505 crore, while revenue from operations increased 18% to Rs 4,225 crore. Despite healthy growth, the stock declined as investors reacted to the quarterly performance.

news.title: Ixigo posts record Q1 profit, but stock tumbles 9%. Here's what worried Dalal Street
news.description: Ixigo shares fell nearly 9% despite the online travel company reporting its highest-ever quarterly profit in Q1FY27. The stock came under pressure after brokerages turned cautious, citing continued investments in hotels, AI and other growth initiatives that could weigh on near-term profitability. Shares later pared losses but remained down over 8% during Friday’s session.

news.title: Closing Auction Session: Why Sebi says the new framework is better than VWAP
news.description: Sebi has defended the new Closing Auction Session (CAS), saying it offers better price discovery and execution certainty than the earlier VWAP-based system. The regulator said CAS aligns Indian markets with global practices and aims to reduce price disruption. Traders, however, remain concerned about unpredictable closing prices and risk management.

news.title: SBI Q1 profit beats estimates on strong loan growth, asset quality
news.description: SBI reported a 10% rise in Q1 net profit to Rs 21,121 crore, beating estimates on robust loan growth and higher net interest income. Improved asset quality, lower bad-loan provisions and strong credit demand offset weaker treasury income and slightly lower margins.

news.title: Raymond Realty Q1 net profit falls 19 pc to Rs 13.43 cr on higher expenses
news.description: Raymond Realty experienced a 19% drop in profit for the quarter that ended in June, primarily due to increased operational costs that affected net earnings. Despite this, the total income rose to Rs 535.71 crore year-on-year. Moreover, the company reported impressive sales bookings of Rs 700 crore in the first quarter of FY27, representing a substantial increase from Rs 306 crore during the same period last year.

news.title: 9 IPOs get Sebi approval as primary market pipeline gathers pace
news.description: Sebi has approved IPOs of nine companies spanning engineering, travel technology, gaming, drones, paper, renewable energy and digital platforms. The approvals strengthen India’s IPO pipeline, with firms including Laxyo, Garuda Aerospace, PlaySimple Games, Rediff.com and Jakson Green preparing to list.

news.title: US stocks: S&P closes at record high as soft jobs report eases rate-hike concerns
news.description: The US stock market enjoyed a significant boost on Friday as the S&P closed at an all-time high. The unexpected rise in job losses led to reduced expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike in September. Strong earnings from corporations further propelled market indices upward. Meanwhile, a dip in oil prices, influenced by advancing peace talks, helped to soothe inflation fears.

news.title: For LIC, successful OFS and strong Q1 may not provide succour yet
news.description: The government's announcement of an offer for sale in LIC has positive implications but the stock trades at a higher multiple versus HDFC Life despite slower growth rates in future

news.title: SBI Q1 Results: Standalone profit rises 10% YoY to Rs 21,121 crore, beats estimates
news.description: State Bank of India reported a ten percent year-on-year net profit growth. Its net interest income also saw a fifteen percent rise during the quarter. Total business crossed one hundred ten trillion rupees, with deposits exceeding sixty trillion. Advances grew nineteen percent year-on-year, driven by broad-based loan segment expansion. Margin improvements were noted, defying earlier analyst expectations of pressure.

news.title: Hindalco Q1 results: Profit soars 75% YoY to record Rs 7,013 crore; revenue jumps 32%
news.description: Hindalco Industries reported a record 75% year-on-year jump in June-quarter consolidated net profit to Rs 7,013 crore, driven by strong India aluminium and copper operations and a recovery at Novelis. Revenue rose 32% to an all-time high of Rs 84,825 crore, while EBITDA surged 73% to Rs 14,989 crore, reflecting robust operational performance despite exceptional expenses.

news.title: Titan Q1 Results: Profit soars 63% YoY to Rs 1,777 crore, total income surges 40%
news.description: Titan Q1 Results: Consumer discretionary major Titan Ltd on Friday reported 63% year-on-year (YoY) growth in its consolidated net profit at Rs 1,777 crore in the first quarter, compared with Rs 1,091 crore in the last year quarter. Total income in the reporting period rose 40% YoY to Rs 20,753 crore.

news.title: Arvind SmartSpaces Q1 Results: Profit zooms 8-fold to Rs 97 crore
news.description: In the June quarter, Arvind SmartSpaces achieved remarkable results with an eight-fold rise in net profit. The company's total income surged to Rs 322.02 crore, while sales bookings more than doubled to Rs 432 crore. This exceptional performance stemmed from robust pre-sales and overall income growth, solidifying the firm's position as a leading player under the Lalbhai Group from Ahmedabad.

news.title: JK Tyre & Industries Q1 Results: Net profit tumbles 73% at Rs 44.09 crore
news.description: In the first quarter of FY27, JK Tyre & Industries reported a staggering 73 percent decline in profits, primarily due to soaring raw material prices linked to the West Asia crisis. Their consolidated net profit plummeted to Rs 44.09 crore from Rs 163.35 crore year-on-year, even as revenue rose to Rs 3,946.24 crore. Notably, domestic volumes surged by 25 percent in both replacement and OE segments.

news.title: Premier Energies Q1 Result: Profit jumps 53% to Rs 472 crore
news.description: Premier Energies reported remarkable growth, with profits soaring more than 53% in the latest quarter. The uptick in revenue can be attributed to robust demand across vital business sectors. The company has made significant strides in enhancing manufacturing, particularly in solar cells and modules. Moreover, plans are underway for new facilities to further elevate production capacities, as Premier Energies invests in expanding its solar initiatives and diversifying into new markets.

news.title: Lupin Q1 PAT rises 16 pc at Rs 1,417 cr
news.description: Lupin Ltd has reported a remarkable sixteen percent surge in profit after tax for the first quarter, showcasing their continued success. The firm experienced considerable growth in consolidated total revenue from operations, largely driven by a staggering forty-two percent increase in sales in the US market. Moreover, sales in India rose nearly fourteen percent, reflecting strong domestic demand.

news.title: Vikram Solar Q1 net profit declines 85 pc to Rs 20 cr
news.description: Vikram Solar experienced an astonishing 85 percent drop in profits for the June quarter, primarily attributable to increased expenses. On a positive note, the company's revenue from operations showed a healthy uptick during this period. In a strategic move, Vikram Solar has also greenlit the expansion of its wafer and ingot manufacturing facility, expected to be operational by fiscal year 2029.

news.title: Sebi streamlines market intermediaries inspection framework, cuts FY27 target to one-third
news.description: Sebi is introducing joint inspections by stock exchanges and depositories, along with a notable reduction in its inspection target for FY27. This strategy intends to enhance oversight while facilitating operations for intermediaries. Moreover, the practice of conducting repetitive annual inspections on compliant entities will cease, shifting focus to alert mechanisms, complaints, and market intelligence for more effective monitoring.

news.title: Hitachi Energy India Q1 Results: Net profit rises over twofold to Rs 294 crore
news.description: Hitachi Energy India has displayed remarkable financial growth with a net profit soaring over 100% in the June quarter. The company reported a substantial increase in operational revenue compared to the previous year. With first-quarter orders reaching Rs 5,096.5 crore for FY27, the firm has achieved a record order backlog totaling Rs 32,222.1 crore, fueled by robust progress in energy transition and security sectors.

news.title: ICICI Bank, Axis Bank tap dollar debt again in less than two months: Report
news.description: ICICI Bank and Axis Bank have returned to the U.S. dollar debt market, each looking to raise $300 million through upcoming bond issues, set to close for subscription next week. Notably, last month saw ICICI Bank raise a substantial $1 billion while Axis Bank secured $800 million. This bond issuance utilizes the Reserve Bank of India's hedging facility to facilitate smoother transactions.

news.title: RBI's Rate Pause Sustains Steady Momentum in Residential Real Estate
news.description: India's residential property sector remains robust, driven by consistent demand and advancements in infrastructure. The Reserve Bank of India's choice to hold the repo rate steady bolsters this positive trend, allowing homebuyers and property developers to make informed, future-focused decisions. With favorable financing conditions, developers can efficiently organize their project timelines and pricing, reinforcing a thriving residential market.

news.title: Fossil Group is said to invite banks for India unit IPO
news.description: Fossil Group Inc. is exploring an initial public offering for its India business. This potential listing could raise as much as $300 million. The US-based company may sell up to a 25% stake in Fossil India. This move follows other multinationals seeking value from their Indian operations. The offering is anticipated to occur early in the coming year.

news.title: Indian bonds clock first weekly rise in five on dovish RBI, easing crude
news.description: Indian government bonds finished the week with little change on Friday, yet celebrated their first gain in five weeks. A decline in oil prices and a calming tone from the central bank helped elevate demand for these bonds. The Reserve Bank of India opted to keep its repo rate steady, alleviating concerns over potential rate hikes in the near future.

news.title: Q1 results 2026: SBI to Ola Electric among companies to declare Q1 results today; full list here
news.description: State Bank of India (SBI), Titan Company, Ola Electric Mobility, Hindalco Industries, Power Finance Corporation, Oil India are among the companies to report their Q1 results FY27 today.

news.title: Tata Sons faces continued listing uncertainty after RBI classification
news.description: The Reserve Bank of India has placed Tata Sons under intensified regulatory oversight. This designation will not influence its ongoing bid to relinquish its NBFC license. Tata Sons had cleared its debts and sought deregistration approximately two years ago. The regulator is expected not to mandate a listing until the application is resolved, which, in turn, affects the philanthropic ventures and investments of Tata Trusts.

news.title: Sebi takes up 402 investigation cases in FY26; completes 338
news.description: Sebi investigated 402 cases in 2025-26 for securities law violations. Fraudulent and unfair trade practices saw 121 cases taken up for scrutiny. Insider trading and illegal trade practices accounted for 224 investigations initiated. Financial statement fraud also came under regulatory focus with 57 cases. Market intermediaries underwent increased surveillance with over 900 brokers inspected.

news.title: Fortis Healthcare Q1 Results: Profit rises 2.3% to Rs 273 crore
news.description: Fortis Healthcare's financial report for the first quarter showcases a promising 2.3 percent rise in profit. The consolidated profit after tax now stands at Rs 273 crore, reflecting growth from last year. Additionally, revenue surged 17.5 percent to reach Rs 2,545 crore. The hospital segment thrived, alongside successful diagnostics operations. Leaders of the company highlighted ongoing investment in infrastructure and a positive business momentum for the future.

news.title: RBI plans to bar NBFCs from offering revolving credit without approval
news.description: In a recent announcement, the Reserve Bank of India has introduced fresh regulations for non-banking financial companies. Moving forward, NBFCs will be restricted to providing only term loans, effectively barring revolving credit offerings, though those currently authorized to issue credit cards are not affected. Standalone NBFCs will require prior permissions and significant funding to independently offer credit cards. The central bank is actively seeking input on these upcoming policies.

news.title: Weekly Expiry: Sensex mirrors Nifty's swings, but with milder spurts
news.description: The recent weekly expiry of Sensex showcased unexpected surges in the index and heightened options premiums. Traders observe that such fluctuations are now standard until liquidity conditions improve. Notably, substantial implied volatility spikes arose without impactful news. Significant trades in ICICI Bank hinted at efforts to sway the index's trajectory. This market landscape creates challenges for option writers while benefiting buyers.

news.title: D-Street braces for weak opening on negative GIFT Nifty cues
news.description: Indian equities appear set for gradual gains, supported by encouraging news. Growing hopes for peace in West Asia and solid Q1FY27 earnings are enhancing investor confidence. Brent crude prices have fallen below eighty dollars per barrel, reflecting optimism in talks. The market will keep an eye on crucial Q1 earnings and US employment figures as the Indian rupee slightly weakened against the dollar on Thursday.

news.title: Stocks in news: LIC, Trent, AWL Agri Business, SBI, Titan
news.description: Indian markets experienced a quiet day of trading on weekly expiry, influenced by varying signals. LIC announced a remarkable 23% increase in its net profit year-on-year, while Trent reported a solid 21% growth in consolidated net profit. PNB Housing is optimistic about its micro-housing loan business aiming for Rs 100 crore. Additionally, Dabur has taken legal action against FSSAI's directive concerning its product claims in the Delhi High Court.

news.title: Banks tone down rate-hike bets as RBI sounds dovish on prices
news.description: Some banks now anticipate fewer policy rate increases from the Reserve Bank of India. Yes Bank and State Bank of India have revised their earlier rate hike forecasts. MUFG Bank has also pushed back its expected policy rate hike timing. Other banks maintain their forecasts for cumulative rate increases this fiscal year. Inflation projections remain sensitive to future crude oil price movements.

news.title: FPIs, trading companies tap Sebi, centre for tax breather
news.description: Investors from abroad are pressing regulators for a decrease in securities transaction taxes to alleviate the burden of double capital gains taxes. With the Reserve Bank of India's stringent leverage rules potentially pushing trading activities offshore, there's a risk of reduced government revenues and diminished market liquidity. Authorities are considering these issues in light of the recent tax cuts on government securities.

news.title: RBI relaxes device-loan recovery norms
news.description: The Reserve Bank of India has updated its regulations on mobile loan financing. Lenders are now required to reinstate device functionality within one hour of confirmation of payment. Additionally, borrower compensation is limited to the total loan amount. These regulations will take effect starting January 1, 2027. Furthermore, technology may be employed to limit device functions following a loan default.

news.title: LIC Q1 profit surges 23% on growth in value of new business
news.description: Life Insurance Corporation of India reported a twenty-three percent net profit rise. Value of new business jumped sixty-one percent, boosting profitability margins significantly. Diversification into non-participating savings and protection products aided this strong performance. The insurer's solvency ratio strengthened, and assets under management also increased. Government's recent offer for sale was well received by the market.

news.title: Specialised realty platforms drive India's next wave of IPOs
news.description: India's real estate sector is on the rise, with innovative public market listings through specialized platforms. These enterprises demonstrate stability with recurring revenue and institutional support, drawing in investors. The surge began with flexible workspace providers post-pandemic, while residential developers and student housing firms are now eyeing their own listings. This movement creates new avenues for investment in the unfolding realty growth landscape.

news.title: Can LEAP India IPO deliver long-term growth for high risk investors?
news.description: LEAP India is on a mission to secure ₹480 crore through a new issuance aimed at settling its debts. Additionally, the company plans to garner ₹2,000 crore via an offer for sale. After acquiring CHEP India, LEAP India has significantly enhanced its asset-pooling network, resulting in a remarkable 41.4% revenue increase year-on-year and a net profit surge of 29.5%. This IPO might attract high-risk investors looking for long-term gains.

news.title: Leap India raises Rs 743.6 crore from 32 anchor investors ahead of IPO launch
news.description: The anchor allocation witnessed participation from some of the world’s most prominent institutional investors, including the Monetary Authority of Singapore, Morgan Stanley India Investment Fund Inc., Goldman Sachs Investments (Mauritius) I Ltd., Government Pension Fund Global, Citigroup Global Markets Mauritius Private Limited, Société Générale – ODI, and BNP Paribas Financial Markets – ODI.

news.title: Trent misses Q1 estimates as store-led growth masks weak demand
news.description: Revenue and profit rose in double digits as the Tata Group retailer accelerated store expansion, but sluggish like-for-like growth at existing outlets weighed on quarterly performance.

news.title: Bharti Airtel stock lacks near-term triggers and even raising stake in Africa biz won’t help much
news.description: Apart from tariff hike, a higher-than-expected IPO valuation for Reliance Industries’ telecom business Jio Platforms, can act as a re-rating catalyst for the Bharti Airtel stock.

news.title: Samvardhana Motherson International Q1 results 2026: Net profit rises 102% to ₹1,032 crore
news.description: Samvardhana Motherson International Q1 results 2026: The company had reported a consolidated net profit of ₹511.84 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year, according to a regulatory filing.

news.title: Navin Fluorine shares jump 14% to record high as analysts stay bullish, lift target price after Q1
news.description: Navin Fluorine's shares jumped 14% to ₹8.647, following strong quarterly results. Brokerages raised target prices, with Axis Securities lifting it to ₹8,600, while JM Financial also raised its target price on the stock to ₹9,000 from ₹8,200

news.title: MV Electrosystems makes a strong debut with 22% premium. Should investors book profits or stay invested?
news.description: MV Electrosystems made a strong stock market debut, listing at over 22% premium to its IPO price. While experts recommend booking partial profits after the sharp listing gains, they advise holding the remaining shares with a stop-loss as the company works to improve profitability.

news.title: Manipal Health shares slide 6% on account of profit booking. What should investors do?
news.description: Manipal Health Enterprises shares fell sharply on Thursday day after their strong market debut, triggering profit booking. Analysts remain constructive on the company's long-term prospects but advise fresh investors to wait for better entry levels, citing premium valuations, while allotted investors can continue holding with a stop-loss at Rs 620.

news.title: Can Tata Sons stay unlisted? Here's what RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra said
news.description: Tata Sons may face renewed pressure to list if the RBI classifies it as an upper-layer NBFC under revised principle-based norms. Governor Sanjay Malhotra said the new framework will simplify classification. With assets above the regulatory threshold, Tata Sons could be required to go public, reviving its long-running IPO debate.

news.title: Indo MIM shares surge 10%, extend gains to 82% over issue price. Should investors book profits?
news.description: Indo-MIM's shares skyrocketed by 82%, surpassing their original IPO price, with robust interest from investors and a firm market position. The company reported impressive financial growth in FY26, with both revenue and profitability on the rise. As a premier global manufacturer, Indo-MIM specializes in precision engineering components through MIM technology, serving a wide range of industries, from automotive to medical devices.

news.title: HDFC Securities initiates coverage on Sona BLW with 'Add'; sees upside on EV-led growth
news.description: HDFC Securities initiated coverage on Sona BLW Precision Forgings with an Add rating and Rs 845 target, citing EV-led growth, strong R&D and product expansion. The brokerage expects sustained margin strength but flagged geopolitical, tariff and promoter-related risks as potential headwinds.

news.title: Sebi proposes investment by REITs, InvITs in third party projects without controlling interest
news.description: Sebi has put forth proposals to permit REITs and InvITs to channel their investments into under-construction projects. This initiative is designed to establish a consistent stream of revenue-producing assets over the long term. Moreover, the regulator plans to shorten the cooling-off period for privately placed InvITs. Notably, common remote infrastructure will now be classified as real estate for REITs.

news.title: Sebi proposes separate master circular for clearing corporations
news.description: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) is set to refine regulations for stock exchanges and clearing corporations. There will be a distinct master circular for clearing entities, alongside enhanced website disclosure obligations. Additionally, existing provisions regarding stock brokers are to be eliminated from current master circulars. This initiative seeks to unify standards and ease the regulatory landscape.

news.title: RBI policy-led India bond rally continues; Friday's debt sale in focus
news.description: Indian government bonds saw a slight increase early Thursday, continuing Wednesday's strong rally. The Reserve Bank of India's dovish stance and falling oil prices supported this upward movement. Investors remain cautious, however, as New Delhi prepares for a significant bond auction on Friday. This auction will test market demand and the sustainability of the recent bond price gains.

news.title: Global Market: European shares hit record high as peace hopes, strong earnings lift sentiment
news.description: European stock markets extended record gains as optimism over a potential U.S.-Iran peace agreement eased energy supply concerns and strong corporate earnings boosted investor confidence. Deutsche Telekom and Glanbia led sectoral advances, while resilient technology shares and improving earnings expectations supported broader market sentiment ahead of euro zone retail sales data.

news.title: Global Market: SoftBank's AI strategy stays on course despite flat OpenAI valuation in Q1
news.description: SoftBank reported an 18% decline in first-quarter net profit, though earnings exceeded expectations as strong gains from Intel and ByteDance investments offset weaker contributions from OpenAI. The company remains focused on expanding its AI portfolio, with major investments, new financing and long-term commitments reinforcing its artificial intelligence growth strategy, according to Reuters.

news.title: Profit-taking, debt supply stall India bond rally
news.description: Indian government bonds exhibited slight fluctuations as profit-taking coincided with substantial debt issuance. The supportive dovish stance from the Reserve Bank of India helped stabilize the situation. Since early August, bond yields have decreased by nearly seven basis points. Market participants are now focused on a major bond auction set for Friday, while overnight indexed swap rates saw a modest rise as traders adjusted their positions.

news.title: Adani's bumper capex trickles down to smaller infra firms
news.description: The Adani Group’s ₹1.53 trillion capex plan for FY26 is emerging as a major growth driver for smaller listed engineering and construction companies. For some, the conglomerate accounted for over 80% of new orders last year, reflecting its growing influence on India’s EPC ecosystem.

news.title: Airtel shifts broadband focus back to fibre, slows FWA push
news.description: Higher hardware costs and weaker customer retention have prompted the telecom operator to curb FWA expansion even as Reliance Jio accelerates AirFiber growth.

news.title: Air India names former Ethiopian Airlines head Tewolde Gebremariam as CEO
news.description: The Tata Group-owned carrier hopes the aviation veteran can replicate his success at Africa's largest airline to stem mounting losses and steer its global expansion.

news.title: RBI hints Tata Sons may remain upper-layer NBFC
news.description: Governor Sanjay Malhotra said the central bank's principle-based framework will determine upper-layer NBFC status, while Tata Sons' listing question continues to hinge on its CIC licence application.

news.title: PB Fintech Q1 Results: Net profit nearly doubles to ₹163 crore; revenue climbs 40%
news.description: PB Fintech reported a Q1FY27 net profit of ₹163 crore, a 92% increase from last year, with revenue rising 40% YoY to ₹1,888 crore. However, both profit and revenue declined sequentially from the previous quarter.

news.title: RBI upper-layer NBFC list to come out soon
news.description: The Reserve Bank of India will soon release a list of upper-layer NBFCs. New principle-based regulations will classify these financial companies into different layers. Companies in the upper layer will be required to publicly list their shares. Tata Sons may be included on this upcoming list of NBFCs. The central bank has not published this specific list since January 2025.

news.title: PB Fintech Q1 Results: Policybazaar parent's profit soars 92% to Rs 163 crore as insurance premium grows 41%
news.description: PB Fintech reported a 92% year-on-year rise in Q1FY27 consolidated profit to Rs 163 crore, driven by robust insurance premium growth, higher operating revenue and improving margins. Operating revenue rose 40%, while total insurance premium increased 41%, supported by strong protection and health insurance demand.

news.title: Sebi settles case against India Power Corp's Raghav Raj Kanoria for Rs 24.7 lakh
news.description: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) has concluded adjudication proceedings against Raghav Raj Kanoria, managing director of India Power Corporation. Kanoria has agreed to pay a settlement sum of Rs 24.7 lakh to settle allegations concerning misstatements in financial records for two fiscal years. He resolved the issue without admitting to any wrongdoing, leading to the conclusion of the proceedings.

news.title: 'No US lawsuits filed yet, ready to defend on facts if needed': HDFC Bank CEO clarifies on governance allegations
news.description: HDFC Bank assured shareholders about its strong governance credentials. No US lawsuits have been filed against the bank following investigations. The bank's leadership stated they are well-positioned to defend any potential legal action. HDFC Bank is fundamentally strong with a pristine balance sheet. The integration with HDFC Limited is unlocking meaningful synergies for future growth.

news.title: No case for early closure or extension of swap window: RBI
news.description: The Reserve Bank of India will not close the swap window early. Robust foreign currency inflows have strengthened India's balance of payments position. The central bank has not received any proposals for extending the deadline. This facility allows banks to swap overseas borrowings at concessional rates. The swap window has already attracted significant dollar inflows by July.

news.title: New framework to standardise interest rate rules on the anvil, says RBI
news.description: The Reserve Bank of India plans to standardize interest rate rules for all regulated entities. This new principle-based framework aims to increase transparency and ensure uniformity across lending. The proposed changes are unlikely to affect EMIs or bring NBFCs into the external benchmark regime. Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated this move will improve consumer protection and rationalise existing norms.

news.title: Liquidity to peak in Sept, but big surplus won't last long: RBI
news.description: The Reserve Bank of India will absorb surplus liquidity from a special forex swap facility. This absorption will occur through higher currency in circulation and maturing forward positions. Banking system liquidity is expected to peak in September due to FCNR(B) deposit inflows. Economists anticipate a surplus of around ₹4-5 lakh crore in the banking system. The central bank will then begin withdrawing excess liquidity through durable absorption measures.

news.title: CAS sparks trader backlash as losses mount, Sebi holds firm
news.description: Concerns are mounting among traders regarding the recent shift to a closing auction system, which has led to significant price volatility. Numerous market participants have reported unexpected losses, prompting authorities to engage with brokers to explore these issues. Despite regulators' attempts to bolster trader involvement, the contentious pricing mechanism continues to stir debate within the financial community.

news.title: Circle shares fall nearly 4% as revenue miss overshadows quarterly profit beat
news.description: Circle's profits in the second quarter significantly outperformed expectations, attributed to the growing adoption of USDC tokens. The surge in USDC circulation, accompanied by a marked increase in onchain transaction activity, highlighted a positive trend. Despite a dip in the reserve return rate during this period, stronger circulation volumes partially mitigated the effects of reduced yields.

news.title: Manipal Health lists at 11% premium
news.description: Manipal Health Enterprises celebrated a successful market entry on Wednesday, with shares launching at ₹652 on the NSE and ₹655 on the BSE, achieving an eleven percent premium. By closing time, the company's market capitalization reached ₹87,229.24 crore. Their impressive initial public offering, valued at ₹9,275 crore, saw nearly five times subscription, making it the year's second-largest IPO, following SBI Funds Management's offering.

news.title: Top realtors line up massive launches to meet FY27 sales aim
news.description: After a weak Q1 marked by delayed launches, India's top four listed developers are betting on over ₹1 trillion of premium project launches to meet their ambitious FY27 sales targets. The success of these launches will be crucial for them to meet their annual sales targets.

news.title: Rate-sensitive stocks rise after RBI MPC outcome; Nifty Auto hits record high, Nifty Realty up over 2.5%
news.description: The RBI's unchanged rates prompted strong buying in rate-sensitive sectors, with the Nifty Auto hitting a record high. The bank upgraded its GDP growth forecast for FY27 to 6.7% and reduced inflation expectations, reflecting overall positive economic sentiment.

news.title: Milky Mist IPO to open on 11 August; cuts issue size by ₹482 crore
news.description: Milky Mist Dairy Food will launch its ₹1,553-crore IPO on 11 August, with subscriptions open until 13 August. The company has reported a significant increase in profit and plans to use IPO proceeds to repay debt and expand facilities.

news.title: Kalyan Jewellers shares extend slide, tumble 5% after Q1 results; down 11% in four days
news.description: Kalyan Jewellers shares fell 5% to ₹562.70 due to disappointing June quarter earnings. Year-on-year net profit rose 32%, but profit declined sequentially. Revenue increased 46% YoY, although gross and EBITDA margins were impacted by changing sales dynamics.

news.title: Stock to buy after Q1 results 2026: Emkay sees over 32% upside in this healthcare stock
news.description: Emkay Global Financial Services maintains its 'Buy' rating on Park Medi World, raising the target price to ₹375 following strong June quarter results, with revenue growth of 19% YoY and profit after tax increasing by 31%. Capacity expands amid risks in government collections.

news.title: Nifty stuck in slow lane even as Sensex rallies 450 pts. How long can this divergence last?
news.description: Sensex and Nifty continued to diverge on Wednesday, with the Sensex gaining over 450 points while Nifty remained largely flat. The divergence comes amid caution following the introduction of the Closing Auction Session (CAS), which triggered sharp volatility in Nifty during Monday’s final minutes. Markets were also reacting to the RBI’s decision to keep the repo rate unchanged.

news.title: MCX shares fall 4% after Q1 profit falls 22% QoQ to Rs 413 crore. What should investors do?
news.description: Multi Commodity Exchange shares fell after reporting lower June quarter profit and revenue. Profit after tax declined twenty-two percent sequentially while revenue also dropped. However, profit surged one hundred three percent year-on-year with strong trading volumes. Operational milestones included significant growth in average daily turnover and active clients. MCX remains dominant domestically and a major global commodity derivatives exchange.

news.title: Nifty can rally to 28,615 by this December in Axis’ bull case scenario. Here’s why
news.description: Axis Direct expects the Nifty to climb to 28,615 by December in its bull-case scenario, driven by a revival in private capex, resilient domestic demand and improving earnings. The brokerage remains overweight on BFSI, healthcare and capital goods, while cautioning that global risks and elevated valuations could trigger near-term volatility.

news.title: Sensex rises 152 points, Nifty closes above 24,600 as market trims gains. What lies ahead?
news.description: Indian equity benchmarks Sensex and Nifty ended higher on Wednesday after the RBI MPC maintained interest rates and raised the FY27 GDP growth outlook. Despite early upswings, markets trimmed gains due to rising crude prices and West Asia tensions. Auto and realty stocks outperformed, while IT shares faced selling pressure.

news.title: The next RBI policy: Likely more of the same
news.description: The RBI's decision to keep the repo rate unchanged and retain a neutral stance signals policy continuity over pre-emptive action. With inflation seen as temporary, financial conditions already tightening and global risks under watch, the central bank is expected to stay on hold in October unless macroeconomic conditions change materially.

news.title: RBI's status quo on rates to support housing demand, keep real estate sentiment intact: Industry
news.description: The RBI's decision to keep the repo rate unchanged at 5.25% for the fourth straight review has received a positive response from the real estate sector. Developers and consultants believe stable interest rates will support housing demand, boost buyer confidence and provide better visibility for project planning. However, rising construction costs remain a concern for affordability, especially in mid-income segments.

news.title: SpaceX posts 92% revenue surge, but stock tumbles 7% in after-hours. Here's why
news.description: SpaceX reported a strong debut quarterly performance as a public company, with revenue surging 92% year-on-year to $7.8 billion in the April–June quarter, driven by robust growth in its Starlink and AI businesses. Despite the strong earnings, the stock fell in after-hours trading as investors reacted to a sharp rise in capital expenditure and concerns over upcoming IPO lock-up expirations.

news.title: Rupee hits one-month closing high as oil slide outweighs RBI pause
news.description: On Wednesday, the Indian rupee climbed to its highest point in a month, bolstered by a dip in crude oil prices that fueled early gains. Although the Reserve Bank of India's decision to maintain rates restricted further growth, analysts pointed out that immediate support lies around 94.75 with resistance levels at 95.60. Additionally, FX inflows and a weakening dollar contributed positively to the rupee's overall sentiment.

news.title: India bonds rally on 'dovish' RBI hold, lower oil prices
news.description: Indian government bonds surged on Wednesday, with yields falling below important levels. The Reserve Bank of India decided to keep the repo rate steady, in line with anticipated market outcomes. A drop in oil prices helped ease inflation fears, supporting the economy. This favorable policy not only uplifted bond markets but also stimulated capital inflows, resulting in reduced overnight index swap rates.

news.title: CREDAI, NAREDCO hail RBI policy, stable home loan interest rate to help sustain housing demand
news.description: The real estate industry's leading organizations, CREDAI and NAREDCO, applaud the RBI's decision to maintain the current repo rate. This move stabilizes home loan rates, which is anticipated to bolster housing demand and offer comfort to buyers. Additionally, the RBI has fine-tuned its GDP outlook and slightly adjusted inflation estimates. Developers emphasize that clear policies enhance project strategies and investment confidence, promoting a robust residential real estate market.

news.title: Hyundai admits slower car launches hurt sales as market share slips
news.description: Hyundai India's domestic sales in FY26 declined 2% 584,906 cars while exports rose 16% to 190,125 units. Mahindra’s sales surged 20% to 660,276 units while Tata Motors PV sales grew 15% to 642,000 units.

news.title: Nykaa says quick delivery isn’t hurting margins as Q1 profit jumps 226%
news.description: FSN E-Commerce's Q1 net profit rose to ₹80 crore as higher order frequency sustained quick-commerce margins, while its fashion arm turned Ebitda-positive.

news.title: Kalyan Jewellers Q1 Results: Net profit jumps 32% YoY to ₹349 crore; margins contract
news.description: Kalyan Jewellers reported a net profit of ₹348 crore for the June quarter, a 32% YoY increase. However, it declined sequentially from ₹409 crore. Revenue rose 46% YoY to ₹10,589 crore, but fell 3% QoQ, with lower contribution from studded jewellery.

news.title: HSBC India profit rises 4% to $965 million in H1 2026, corporate and institutional banking drives growth
news.description: HSBC India's profit before tax rose four percent in the first half of 2026. Higher revenue from corporate and institutional banking fueled this significant profit increase. The bank's wealth and premier banking division, however, saw profits drop sharply. HSBC India also led in mobilising foreign currency deposits under a special RBI scheme. Globally, HSBC reported a substantial twenty-three percent rise in pre-tax profit.

news.title: PNB Housing Q1 profit rises 4% as loan book grows 15%
news.description: PNB Housing Finance posted a 4.3% rise in June-quarter net profit as loan assets and AUM recorded double-digit growth. Net interest margin narrowed, while asset quality improved with lower gross NPAs despite higher operating expenses during the quarter.

news.title: Closing auction keeps traders on edge as divergence persists
news.description: Market participants faced confusion with the new closing auction system on Tuesday. This system change affected the determination of official stock closing prices. The expiry of Nifty weekly futures and options contracts added to market complexity. Traders reported unexpected derivative price movements and position losses. The Sensex and Nifty experienced divergence for a second consecutive day.

news.title: REITs, publicly-listed InvITs may get to raise foreign capital via DRs
news.description: Sebi proposed allowing real estate and infrastructure trusts to raise foreign capital. This move aims to broaden foreign investor access to India's investment trust market. Depository receipts will enable trading in foreign currency on international exchanges. Privately listed infrastructure trusts will not be eligible for this new facility. The proposal seeks to attract more global capital into these investment vehicles.

news.title: Stocks in news: BSE, PB Fintech, Nykaa, Airtel, and LIC
news.description: Markets experienced profit-taking after Monday's rally, with indices closing lower. Investors await the Reserve Bank of India's monetary policy announcement on Wednesday. BSE reported a significant profit increase for the June quarter, driven by revenue growth. Bharti Airtel and Nykaa also announced strong quarterly earnings, showing substantial profit jumps. The government began an offer for sale in LIC for non-retail investors.

news.title: Spotify's higher spending on marketing, AI features to hit profit
news.description: Spotify anticipates that increased marketing and development expenditures will adversely affect profits in the current quarter. The platform forecasts its third-quarter monthly active users to fall short of Wall Street's expectations, a decline attributed to product changes in emerging markets. To counteract this, Spotify is investing significantly in AI features aimed at attracting and retaining its user base, alongside introducing a new agreement for fan-generated covers and remixes.

news.title: Drugmaker Pfizer beats earnings estimates, targets $2.5 billion in additional cost cuts
news.description: Pfizer has reported impressive second-quarter earnings, driven by the success of Eliquis and newly acquired pharmaceutical products. The company is planning $2.5 billion in cost-saving measures expected to be in place by 2029. With a focus on innovative treatments, Pfizer aims to reduce reliance on older, high-grossing medications and looks forward to a notable growth revival post-2028, actively pushing its obesity treatment initiatives.

news.title: SK Hynix rises 5% as brokerages launch coverage with bullish ratings
news.description: SK Hynix shares jumped five percent as brokerages began coverage with positive assessments, spurred by the company's strong position within the artificial intelligence memory sector. Although there was a recent dip, the U.S. listing enhances global investor accessibility. Despite reporting record quarterly profits, shipment delays caused a miss on analyst expectations. Nonetheless, robust orders from U.S. tech firms bolster forecasts for ongoing AI infrastructure investments.

news.title: US stocks: Dow, S&P 500 close at record highs as AI earnings impress, oil prices tumble
news.description: Stock markets soared to all-time highs on Tuesday, fueled by stellar earnings from corporations. AI-focused entities like Palantir and the esteemed Caterpillar delivered eye-popping results. The drop in oil prices and Treasury yields created a favorable backdrop for continued growth. Moreover, the possibility of a peaceful resolution in the Iran conflict greatly enhanced investor optimism. Overall, corporate earnings have been significantly exceeding forecasts this reporting period.

news.title: US stocks: SpaceX quarterly revenue surges in debut results on strong growth in its Starlink business
news.description: SpaceX has announced an impressive 92% increase in revenue for the latest quarter, primarily fueled by the growth of Starlink and its AI initiatives. Despite this surge, the firm faced a net loss due to significant capital allocated towards infrastructure and future projects. After a strong IPO, its stock is now under scrutiny, especially with the impending lock-up expiration.

news.title: Rupee remains stable at 95.37 ahead of RBI policy outcome
news.description: The Indian rupee closed nearly unchanged on Tuesday, trading within a narrow band. Importer hedging demand and FPI inflows supported the currency's stability. Caution ahead of the monetary policy announcement also influenced its movement. Brent crude prices remained between eighty and eighty-three dollars per barrel. The rupee settled at ninety-five point thirty-seven against the dollar.

news.title: Dhoot Transmission IPO priced at Rs 829-871
news.description: Dhoot Transmission has set the price band for its ₹3,067-crore IPO at ₹829–871 per share. The public issue will be open for subscription from August 10 to 12, with Axis Capital, Jefferies India, Kotak Mahindra Capital, Nomura Financial Advisory and Securities, SBI Capital Markets, and 360 ONE WAM serving as the book-running lead managers.

news.title: Bharti Airtel Q1 Results: Profit climbs on higher subscriber upgrades, robust data usage
news.description: Bharti Airtel reported a consolidated net profit of ₹8,167 crore for Q1FY27, a 37.3% YoY increase, announced on August 04. However, net profit declined 11.5% compared to ₹7,325 crore in Q4FY26.

news.title: Nykaa Q1 Results: Net profit surges over threefold to ₹80 crore on strong beauty demand
news.description: FSN E-Commerce Ventures, Nykaa's parent, reported a 226% YoY increase in profit to ₹80 crore for the June quarter, driven by rising sales and improved margins. Revenue rose 29% YoY to ₹2,782 crore, led by strong demand in skincare and makeup.

news.title: Epack Prefab Technologies shares rally 10% after Q1 revenue jumps 24%
news.description: Epack Prefab Technologies shares surged over 10% after the company reported a 24% year-on-year rise in June-quarter revenue, supported by strong project execution and regional expansion. While margins softened due to higher input costs, the company expects them to recover in the coming quarters as capacity additions and a healthy order book support growth.

news.title: ICICI Securities initiates coverage on 7 PSU banks with positive valuations
news.description: ICICI Securities commenced its analysis on seven public sector banks, giving most a Buy rating. They predict a strong return on equity for these institutions leading up to fiscal year twenty twenty-eight. Loan growth should remain vigorous, estimated at fourteen to fifteen percent each year. While asset quality is likely to stay stable, they caution about possible disruptions related to oil and climate change.

news.title: Aimtron Electronics shares can rally to Rs 2,036? Here’s why Nuvama initiated coverage on the platform stock
news.description: Nuvama Wealth Management has initiated coverage on Aimtron Electronics with a Buy rating and a target price of Rs 2,036, implying nearly 47% upside. The brokerage expects strong growth driven by the company's shift to high-margin ESDM solutions, expanding order book, capacity additions and global expansion through its US acquisition.

news.title: Sebi aims to relax offshore fund investor-disclosure rules as appeals grow: Report
news.description: India's market regulator is set to simplify disclosure requirements for offshore funds to entice more long-term foreign investment. The proposed adjustments include extending the disclosure timelines for fresh investors and increasing the thresholds for reporting specific investor information. These initiatives emerged in response to legal challenges and complaints from investors, seeking to create a more conducive environment for capital influx.

news.title: Jindal Stainless Q1 net profit up 8%, price hikes offset cost surge
news.description: Jindal Stainless production dipped during the June quarter due to West Asia conflict disruptions. However, price increases helped ease some of the cost pressures experienced. Consolidated net profit rose nearly 8% while revenue increased by ten percent. Sales volume dropped over 7%, impacted by fuel supply chain issues. The company's net debt decreased, and its net debt-to-EBITDA ratio improved.

news.title: Sensex falls 210 points, Nifty closes below 24,650 as market snaps 4-day gaining streak
news.description: Indian benchmark indices ended lower on Tuesday, snapping a four-day winning streak as the Sensex dropped 210 points to 78,429 and the Nifty fell 159 points to 24,615. Volatility stemmed from weekly expiry and discrepancies under the newly introduced Closing Auction Session (CAS) framework, which triggered forced square-offs ahead of the RBI policy outcome.

news.title: India's new closing auction stokes sharp Nifty swings, options volatility on weekly expiry
news.description: India's Nifty 50 index faced notable volatility yet again, largely driven by the recent implementation of a new closing price mechanism. This development coincided with the expiration of weekly derivative contracts, which created turmoil among traders. As the Nifty 50 moved lower, experts indicated the necessity for critical adjustments to the new pricing system to address the prevailing issues.

news.title: Sebi proposes depository receipts against REITs, InvITs units
news.description: India's markets regulator has unveiled a fresh set of regulations concerning depository receipts aimed at real estate and infrastructure investment trusts. This initiative seeks to draw increased foreign investment into these vital sectors, providing overseas investors with a new channel to trade these units. Interested parties must submit their feedback on the proposals by August twenty-fifth.

news.title: India bonds rise on position building ahead of RBI policy
news.description: Indian government bonds saw a slight increase as traders positioned themselves before the RBI's policy announcement. The Reserve Bank of India is widely expected to maintain its key policy rate unchanged on Wednesday. Rising oil prices, however, limited the upward movement in bond yields during the session. Traders will closely monitor the RBI for guidance on liquidity and economic forecast revisions.

news.title: DLF confident of meeting FY27 pre-sales target of Rs 20K cr despite weak Q1: MD
news.description: DLF Ltd aims to reach its ambitious Rs 20,000 crore sales target this fiscal year, despite a considerable drop in pre-sales in the June quarter owing to a lack of new project launches. The company is now prioritizing cash flow enhancement and investigating strategic land purchases in the Delhi-NCR region.

news.title: Godrej Properties Q1 Results: Profit falls 42% to Rs 349 crore, sales bookings rise 22%
news.description: Godrej Properties saw a forty-two percent profit drop in the June quarter. Total income also decreased compared to the previous year's corresponding period. However, sales bookings increased by twenty-two percent to over eight thousand six hundred crore. The company sold three thousand seven hundred thirty-eight units during the quarter. Executive Chairperson Pirojsha Godrej expressed confidence in continued sales momentum.

news.title: Keystone Realtors Q1 profit jumps over 3-times to Rs 52cr
news.description: Keystone Realtors has announced an impressive profit growth in the latest quarter, with net profits climbing to Rs 52.37 crore, up from Rs 16.33 crore. Total income soared to Rs 493.26 crore, reflecting healthy demand in the real estate market. Additionally, pre-sales hit Rs 617 crore, buoyed by a robust homebuyer sentiment, while the company ensures a solid financial foundation for upcoming ventures.

news.title: Ajmera Realty & Infra Q1 profit rises 14% to Rs 45cr
news.description: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Ltd reported an impressive fourteen percent increase in net profit, amounting to Rs 44.94 crore for June. Alongside this, the company's total income surged to Rs 319.52 crore in the first quarter, indicating a remarkable year-on-year performance. As one of India's top real estate firms, Ajmera continues to demonstrate robust growth.

news.title: Fewer jobs in the market? Some of India's top companies are hiring less
news.description: Among the 30 Sensex companies, total new hires at nine companies fell 27% in FY26 compared to FY24 while two companies hired more, a Mint analysis found. The remaining companies either do not disclose or only partially disclose fresh hiring numbers.

news.title: ICICI Lombard shifts focus from risk transfer to risk management
news.description: On Monday, the general insurer launched 25 products and features to mark 25 years of operations, many of which are backed by technology and artificial intelligence.

news.title: Sensex jumps over 500 points, Nifty 50 ends above 24,750; investors earn ₹4 lakh crore in a day
news.description: The Sensex ended the day 544 points, or 0.70%, higher at 78,639, while the Nifty 50 ended 391 points, or 1.60%, higher at 24,774.30.

news.title: Top Gainers & Losers on 3 August: Urban Company, Pine Labs, Redington, Paytm, TCS, Meesho among top gainers
news.description: Indian equities surged nearly 1% on Monday, led by a decline in crude oil prices and strong IT sector buying. The Nifty 50 rose to 24,573 and the Sensex to 78,677, extending gains to a fourth session. Nifty IT and Private Bank were top gainers.

news.title: HSBC, SBI and ICICI Bank get half of India's FCNR flows under incentive window
news.description: Public sector banks got $8.8 billion under the scheme, private sector banks $10.7 billion and foreign banks $8.4 billion. The remaining came into small finance banks and cooperative banks, the data showed.

news.title: Why did Nifty 50 jump 200 points in the final minutes of trade? Here's what happened
news.description: The Indian stock market saw unusual divergence as the Nifty 50 surged 1.60% to 24,773, while the Sensex gained 0.70% to 78,639. This occurred due to SEBI's new Closing Auction Session mechanism aimed at improving price discovery.

news.title: SBI Funds Q1 Results: PAT rises 3% YoY to ₹873 crore in first earnings after listing
news.description: SBI Funds Management reported a standalone profit of ₹873 crore for the June quarter, up 3.3% from last year. Despite weak market sentiment, retail investor confidence remained strong, with equity inflows driving QAAUM growth to ₹12.6 trillion, maintaining its largest asset manager status.

news.title: New closing auction sparks rare Nifty-Sensex split amid low participation
news.description: Brokers mixed in view with some terming the 200 pt surge in Nifty in two minutes an anomaly, while others attributed lower awareness leading to a demand -supply mismatch

news.title: Sebi extends PaRRVA enrollment deadline to Sep 3 for investment advisers, research analysts
news.description: Sebi has granted a new extension for investment advisers and research analysts regarding their enrolment, now set for September 3, 2026. This delay allows participants more time to finalize their registrations, facilitating a more seamless rollout of the performance data framework. It’s essential for advisers and analysts to enroll to provide their past performance metrics.

news.title: MakeMyTrip Q1 bookings rise 20%; AI assistant drives growth
news.description: MakeMyTrip reported a 19.9% year-on-year rise in Q1 gross bookings to $2.85 billion, while revenue and adjusted operating profit increased despite travel disruptions. Strong growth across hotels, buses and AI-powered Myra 2.0 reinforced confidence in India’s long-term travel demand.

news.title: Kansai Nerolac Q1 profit rises 5%; approves Rs 601 crore capacity expansion
news.description: Paintmaker cites healthy demand despite geopolitical disruptions; expects festive season to support growth.

news.title: Muthoot Microfin case: Sebi exempts six family trusts from open offer obligation
news.description: Sebi has exempted six Muthoot family trusts from an open offer requirement. This exemption pertains to the indirect acquisition of shares in Muthoot Microfin. The restructuring involves multiple share transfers among family trusts and spouses. Muthoot Fincorp's board approved an IPO, necessitating transaction structure changes. The exemption is valid for one year and subject to reporting conditions.

news.title: New closing auction triggers confusion, sparks late Nifty swings
news.description: Market participants faced confusion during the new auction system's debut. Indices and stock values diverged significantly, catching traders by surprise. The new system determines closing prices through a separate auction process. This change aims to create more robust closing prices for derivatives. Tuesday's derivatives expiry will be a key test for the new system.

news.title: ITC Q1 earnings hit by cigarette tax burden; FMCG, paper businesses offer support
news.description: ITC's June 2026 earnings fell due to higher cigarette taxes and disruptions. Resilient growth in the consumer segment cushioned the overall impact. Categories like dairy and snacks showed strong year-on-year gains. The paperboards and packaging business also saw a significant recovery. Analysts have reduced earnings estimates for upcoming fiscal years.

news.title: US stocks: Dow closes at record high on Iran talks optimism
news.description: US stocks opened August with strong gains, pushing the Dow Industrials to a record closing high. Easing oil prices and Treasury yields supported the market's upward movement. Communication services sector led gains, while energy experienced a decline. Amazon's market value surpassed three trillion dollars for the first time. Investors are now focused on upcoming economic data and corporate earnings reports.

news.title: Bharti Airtel Q1 may see steady growth, flat Arpu
news.description: Bharti Airtel's net profit is expected to increase 47% on-year and 20% on-quarter to ₹8,759 crore in Q1FY27.

news.title: DLF’s Q1 sales bookings crash 94% to ₹657 crore on deferred launches
news.description: The lack of fresh launches dragged down Q1 sales bookings, but strong cash generation and an upcoming ₹20,000-crore launch pipeline keep DLF's FY27 targets on track.

news.title: Healthcare stock Park Medi World inches close to record high after the Q1 results 2026
news.description: Park Medi World share price ascended for the fourth straight session during the Monday morning dealings

news.title: ITC share price rallies 4% despite a drop in Q1 profit. Should you buy, sell FMCG stock after Q1 results 2026?
news.description: FMCG giant ITC share price surged as much as 3.81% on NSE in Monday's trading session despite the conglomerate posted weaker-than-expected performance for the April-June quarter (Q1 FY26-27).

news.title: This infra stock to declare bonus shares, dividend soon. Details here
news.description: Chavda Infra's board will meet on August 6, 2026, to consider various proposals including bonus shares and dividends, subject to approvals. The trading window remains closed in accordance with SEBI regulations until further notice.

news.title: Thangamayil Jewellery shares crash 32% in a week. What should investors do?
news.description: Thangamayil Jewellery shares fell 5%, extending their one-week decline to 32%, after the company said it saw no visible improvement in sales during the first 28 days of Q2 FY27. The jeweller attributed the weakness to higher import duty, rupee depreciation, geopolitical uncertainty and continued customer reluctance amid expectations of lower gold prices.

news.title: One MobiKwik Q1 Results: Firm reports profit for 3rd consecutive quarter; stock jumps 9% on strong performance
news.description: Fintech firm MobiKwik reported a consolidated profit of Rs 7.6 crore for the April-June quarter. This marks a significant turnaround from a net loss of Rs 41 crore in the prior year. Revenue from operations saw a modest increase of 3.7 percent to Rs 281.48 crore. The company highlighted three consecutive profitable quarters, reinforcing its business model's embedded profitability.

news.title: Nifty Q1 earnings grow 11% to beat estimate, says Motilal Oswal; picks Bharti Airtel, SBI, ICICI Bank among top bets
news.description: Nifty companies have posted a stronger-than-expected start to Q1 earnings, with profits of 39 reporting constituents rising 11% YoY, beating Motilal Oswal’s 7% estimate. Reliance Industries, JSW Steel, ICICI Bank, Bajaj Finance and Axis Bank drove 59% of incremental earnings growth, while InterGlobe Aviation, ITC, Dr Reddy’s, Cipla and Maruti Suzuki dragged.

news.title: Tata Motors CV shares rise 4% as July sales jump 37% YoY. Nomura expects Iveco to support earnings recovery; check target price
news.description: Tata Motors CV rose sharply after the company reported a 37% year-on-year jump in July commercial vehicle sales. While Nomura remains cautious on near-term demand, it expects the Iveco acquisition, cost efficiencies and new product launches to drive earnings recovery over the next two years.

news.title: Swiggy shares fall 6% in 2 days despite strong Q1 earnings. Should you buy, sell or hold?
news.description: Swiggy shares declined six percent over two days despite reporting strong first-quarter earnings. The company's net loss decreased by thirty-four percent year-on-year in the first quarter. Revenue from operations increased more than thirty-seven percent year-on-year during the April-June quarter. Analysts offered mixed recommendations, with some maintaining buy ratings and others downgrading the stock. The focus remains on achieving profitability in quick commerce while sustaining food delivery growth.

news.title: Zinc India to remain at the driver seat for Vedanta, says ICICI Securities but cuts target price to Rs 345
news.description: ICICI Securities cut Vedanta’s target price to Rs 345 from Rs 369, while retaining a positive view on zinc and silver prices. Zinc India remains the key growth driver, contributing 95% of Vedanta’s EBITDA.

news.title: Greaves Electric Mobility’s Rs 530 crore rights issue offer gets fully subscribed
news.description: Greaves Electric Mobility's Rs 530 crore rights issue was fully subscribed by existing shareholders, reinforcing confidence in the EV maker's growth strategy. The company will use the funds to expand its product pipeline and technology capabilities while deferring its proposed IPO until market conditions and regulatory approvals become more favourable.

news.title: Ather Energy Q1 Results: Loss narrows YoY to Rs 51 crore on stronger sales
news.description: Ather Energy, the Indian electric scooter manufacturer, has announced a significant reduction in its quarterly losses, attributing this positive outcome to robust sales that overshadowed increased expenses. The net loss for the June quarter was reported at 508.7 million rupees, a notable improvement compared to the previous year's substantial loss. This financial performance showcases the company's progressive trajectory in the market.

news.title: Market wrap: TCS, IndiGo, Sun Pharma among top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Monday
news.description: Indian benchmark indices surged on Monday after easing crude oil prices, sparked by renewed US-Iran talks, boosted investor sentiment. The Sensex jumped 544 points and the Nifty climbed 1.6%, adding nearly Rs 5 lakh crore to BSE market capitalisation. TCS, IndiGo and Infosys led gains, while Sun Pharma and Apollo Hospitals lagged.

news.title: RBI sells USD 14.9 bn during Jan-May to check excess volatility in rupee
news.description: In an effort to stabilize the rupee, the Reserve Bank of India sold USD 14.9 billion. Banks are also re-engaging with defaulters to recover substantial written-off loans. The SWAMIH Fund has been effective in funding 147 projects, benefitting many home buyers. Interestingly, defaults on gold loans have plummeted for both banks and NBFCs. Moreover, Kisan Credit Card accounts now reflect over Rs 10 lakh crore in outstanding credit.

news.title: Sun Pharma misses Q1 estimates as US generics drag offsets India growth
news.description: Revenue and profit rose in double digits in the June quarter, but softer US generics sales and margin pressure saw India's largest drugmaker missing Street expectations.

news.title: ITC profit slips as cigarette tax hike, agri slowdown weigh on Q1
news.description: Revenue rose on strong FMCG growth, but higher cigarette taxes, weaker agri exports and rising input costs squeezed earnings as ITC warned of imported inflation and a weak monsoon.

news.title: Adani Airport Holdings among 10 bidders in second phase of privatisation of Catania airport: Sicily's SAC
news.description: Adani Airport Holdings, Vinci Airports and Royal Schiphol Group are among 10 bidders that have advanced to the second phase of the privatisation of Sicily's Catania airport.

news.title: Urban Company Q1: Fastest growth in four years, but InstaHelp spending pushes firm into loss
news.description: Urban Company reported 44% revenue growth in Q1 as its core home-services business, international operations and Native products gathered momentum, but aggressive investment in InstaHelp and a deferred tax expense weighed on profitability.

news.title: Dixon misses Q1 profit estimates as margin pressure offsets revenue growth
news.description: A 23% rise in cost of materials to ₹15,064 crore further hit profitability. The cost pressures also affected Dixon’s operating margin, which in the June quarter took an 80 basis points (bps) hit to drop to 3% for the period.

news.title: India's SEBI imposes penalty of 14.8 million rupees on Zee Entertainment
news.description: Markets regulator Securities ​and Exchange Board of India on Friday said it has imposed a penalty of 14.8 million rupees ($155,168.80) on Zee Entertainment, its CEO Punit Goenka and chairman emeritus Subhash Chandra.

news.title: RBI special windows seen big enough to bring in $100B
news.description: India's new forex inflow programs may attract approximately one hundred billion dollars. These special drives have already mobilized over forty billion dollars in foreign exchange. Experts predict these initiatives could significantly exceed initial mobilization estimates. The Reserve Bank of India introduced these facilities to support the balance of payments. These programs aim to cushion the rupee and contain imported inflation.

news.title: Value addition key for Tata Steel as prices fall and costs increase
news.description: Tata Steel saw strong revenue growth in the June quarter, driven by higher realisations. However, global steel prices are softening, and coking coal costs are rising. The company expects domestic realisations to decrease in the September quarter. Tata Steel is increasing its focus on value-added products and expanding its NINL facility. This strategic shift aims to strengthen its position in high-margin segments.

news.title: RBI likely to extend rate pause; neutral stance seen unchanged
news.description: Economists anticipate the Reserve Bank of India will maintain its current interest rate at 5.25 percent. The central bank is also expected to keep its neutral monetary policy stance for the fourth review. Some economists foresee a potential rate hike in the second half of fiscal year twenty twenty-seven. Inflation forecasts for fiscal year twenty twenty-seven are divided among surveyed economists.

news.title: AI trade unwind, FII inflows brighten August outlook for Indian stocks
news.description: Indian equities are expected to extend recent gains in August, supported by foreign fund inflows. Analysts anticipate a continued upward move for the Nifty after recent consolidation periods. Foreign institutional investors have turned positive, marking their first net purchases since February. While geopolitical uncertainties remain, the unwinding of AI trade is seen as positive. Select large caps and specific sectors like NBFCs, pharma, metals, and realty may perform well.

news.title: D-St set for a positive opening as GIFT Nifty signals firm start
news.description: Domestic markets extended their winning streak for a third consecutive session. Nifty advanced nearly two percent last week, driven by strong quarterly earnings. Analysts expect Indian equities to trade with a positive bias this week. Investors will monitor the RBI's monetary policy decision and PMI data. Crude oil prices and geopolitical tensions in West Asia remain key watchpoints.

news.title: Stocks in news: Maruti Suzuki, ITC, ZEE, Persistent Systems, and Muthoot Finance
news.description: Markets extended their winning streak on Friday, supported by encouraging quarterly business updates. Nifty strengthened its bullish structure by surpassing the 200-day EMA, positioning for further gains. ITC reported a net profit drop while revenue rose, and Maruti Suzuki saw a net profit decline. Sun Pharma reported net profit growth, and PNB has no immediate plans to monetize subsidiaries.

news.title: Nifty rally has enough steam left to move closer to 25,000: Analysts
news.description: Experts suggest a moderately bullish strategy for Nifty options with defined risk and reward. Jio Financial Services and Hero MotoCorp are recommended buys with specific price targets. Ashok Leyland and Havells India also present buying opportunities based on technical breakouts. Bharti Airtel and Sona BLW Precision Forgings show strong upward momentum. Analysts advise a buy-on-dips approach for Nifty and Bank Nifty indices.

news.title: Seasonal tailwinds set the stage for select stock rallies
news.description: August's historical seasonality favors Indian equities, with analysts identifying key stocks. Derivatives data reveals fresh long positioning in Delivvery and Aditya Birla Capital. Jio Financial witnessed a bullish breakout, while Bajaj Holdings shows strong accumulation. Muthoot Finance is well positioned to extend its gains, analysts noted. Conversely, LIC Housing Finance faces bearish bets after a technical breakdown.

news.title: HDFC, ICICI Bank rates up for dollar deposits
news.description: Banks are raising FCNR(B) deposit rates to attract dollars amid global rate increases. ICICI Bank and HDFC Bank have already adjusted their offerings for dollar deposits. Higher overseas borrowing costs and market competition necessitate these rate adjustments. Global benchmark rates have risen since the scheme's operationalization in June. This special scheme for attracting foreign currency closes on September 30.

news.title: Shree Cement Q1 profit falls as West Asia disruptions drive up fuel costs
news.description: A strong volume growth failed to offset higher input costs after supply disruptions forced a costlier fuel mix, though the company expects profitability to improve from Q2 if geopolitical tensions remain stable.

news.title: RBI MPC meeting to Q1 results FY27, US-Iran war: Top five triggers that may dictate the Indian stock market this week
news.description: Stock market today: The Nifty climbed 2.59% to end at 24,383.60, while the Sensex rose 2.68% to close at 78,094.64. While some of the global triggers continue this week, read on to know what are the fresh factors to watch out for this week.

news.title: Maharashtra-based SME stock plunges 20% as MD gets shot, director taken in police custody
news.description: In an exchange filing, GSM Foils said the firing incident took place in the Naikpada area in Vasai-Virar, located near Mumbai. After getting injured in the incident, the company said that Parmar received prompt medical attention and is presently under proper medical care. His health condition was reported to be stable and improving.

news.title: Jio Financial Services sets record date for dividend. Check details
news.description: Jio Financial Services set August 10 as the record date for its final dividend. The company reported significant year-on-year profit and revenue growth in the first quarter. Interest income and fees and commission income saw substantial increases during this period. Jio Financial Services shares experienced a notable jump on Friday and over the week. Motilal Oswal maintains a Buy rating with a target price of Rs 315.

news.title: Divi's Labs Q1 Results: Net profit rises 66% YoY to Rs 902 crore, revenue up 28%
news.description: The firm’s revenue from operations meanwhile rose around 28% YoY to Rs 3,080 crore in Q1 FY27, from Rs 2,410 crore reported in the year-ago period. Its total income increased over 24% YoY to Rs 3,144 crore, while total expenses rose more than 9% YoY to Rs 1,964 crore during the quarter which ended on June 30, 2026.
